intro: Front support and back support waddles/walks
Practice the stretch tall and step into the handstand
Kick to handstand, arms up fast at the end
On knees, work out which way they turn, practice the hand action

levels: Lunge Steps/Needle Kicks, High Five the Floor hands up after each step
Mini Handstand (handstand but don’t let the feet join)
Handstand Hold (can do a competition with partner or count each other)
Handstand Half/Full Pirouette

0.s: Lunge hold for 3s on each leg (arms by ear)
Arms above head, on toes, lean forward to lunge position

cues: Long lunge, arms squeezing your ears.
Tight like a pencil, toes to the ceiling.
Push tall through your shoulders, then turn.
tips.watch: Bent arms and an arched, banana back make the handstand collapse. Keep arms straight by the ears, ribs pulled in and bottom squeezed before adding any turn.
tips.safety: Teach a safe exit first: turn out and step down. Space gymnasts well apart so a falling handstand hits no one.

levels: Log Roll Along Panel Mat, bean bag between feet
Lay on Back in Tuck (scarf under lower back) Partner Pull Scarf Away - gymnast needs to squeeze abs to flatten back
Lay on Back in Dish (scarf under lower back) Partner Pull Scarf Away - gymnast needs to squeeze abs to flatten back
Lay on Back in Stretch (scarf under lower back) Partner Pull Scarf Away - gymnast needs to squeeze abs to flatten back

0.s: Tight Posture Rolls along Fast Track

cues: Squeeze your tummy, press your back into the mat.
Stay long and tight like a pencil.
Roll as one piece, keep the bean bag in.
tips.watch: The lower back lifts, so the scarf slides out easily. Tilt the hips under and press the back flat; if they can't, go back to the easier shape until they can.

levels: Handstand Flatback with Support
Handstand Forward Roll
Handstand Hold (mat there in case they fall)
Handstand Half Turn, Land on Belly

cues: Arms by your ears, look at your hands.
Tight body, toes pointed to the ceiling.
Chin to your chest before you roll.
tips.watch: Arms bending as they come down, so they land on the head in the roll or crash on the flatback. Keep arms locked and push tall through the shoulders.
tips.safety: Rolls go onto the back of the shoulders, never the top of the head. Support flatbacks at the hips and thighs, guiding them down.

levels: Stretch and Half Turn Jump (how many can they stick?)
Half Turn or Full Turn Jump (how many can they stick?)
1.5 Turn Jump or Half Turn Tuck/Wolf Jump
Double Turning Jump Half Turn Straddle Jump Full Turn Tuck/Wolf Jump

0.s: Half Turn Jump
2 x Penguin Jumps into Half Jump Turn

cues: Jump up first, then turn.
Arms tight above your head to spin.
Stick it: soft knees and freeze for three.
tips.watch: Starting the turn before leaving the floor, with arms swinging out sideways. Jump straight up, pull arms in tight overhead, and only add more turn once they land facing the right way.
tips.safety: Land on soft bent knees with feet hip-width apart. Spread gymnasts out so turning jumps don't collide.

levels: Bunny Hop Around Obstacle Course
Front Support (feet on slider) Walk Around Obstacle Course
Wheelbarrow Walk with Partner Around Obstacle Course
Handstand Walk Around Obstacle Course

1.s: Front support to squat, return to front suppport using slider (Squat Thrust)

cues: Shoulders over your hands, push the floor away.
Tummy tight, no saggy back.
Small steps with your hands.
tips.watch: Hips sagging or bottom sticking up in front support and wheelbarrow. Squeeze tummy and bottom to keep a straight line; partners hold nearer the knees to make it easier.
tips.safety: Partners hold wheelbarrow legs at the thighs or knees, walk at the walker's speed and never drop the legs or push them forward. Foam blocks and wedges don’t work with sliders: for the slider rung, use soft play, hoops and spots.

levels: Mini Cartwheel Down Wedge, placing feet on correct colour spots
Cartwheel Down Wedge
Dive Cartwheel/Hurdle Down Block into (Dive) Cartwheel
Free Cartwheel Down or Off Wedge (can go either way but mat the drop if going off)

cues: Hand, hand, foot, foot, like a wheel.
Reach long down the slope, legs high over the top.
Look at your hands until your feet land.
tips.watch: Bent, piked legs that flop round low. Ask for straight legs passing over the top of the wedge, and use the colour spots to keep hands and feet in a line.
tips.safety: Mat the drop at the end of the wedge for free cartwheels, and only let Advanced try them once their dive cartwheel is solid.

levels: Hands on the Floor, Jump Side to Side OVER block
Cartwheel Off Panel Mat (hands on mat)
Pop Cartwheel Off (push off hands for flight)
FINAL SKILL: Dive or Free Cartwheel Off

0.s: Side to side bunny hop over low box top.

cues: Hands down first, then jump your feet over.
Push hard through your hands to fly.
Stretch tall and land with soft knees.
tips.watch: Children jump off the mat without pushing through their arms, so there is no flight. Practise the hand push on the floor first, then ask for a little gap before landing.
tips.safety: Make sure the panel mat is stable and there is a landing mat at the drop. Only allow free cartwheels if they have shown a strong dive cartwheel.

levels: Straddle Bunny Hops Along
Front to Back Cartwheel
FINAL SKILL: 1 Handed Cartwheel (start arms up, swing to side and finish up against)
Bad Leg Cartwheel Cartwheel From Knee Dive/Free Cartwheel Can use a springboard if needed for the free cartwheel

0.s: 10 x Straddled Bunny Hops along Fast Track

cues: Arms up by your ears to start and finish.
Kick your back leg up high and straight.
Stay in a straight line, like you're on a tightrope.
tips.watch: Children bend at the hips and swing the legs round the side. Keep arms by the ears at start and finish, and kick the back leg high through the middle.
tips.safety: For free cartwheels off a springboard, use a matted landing and a space clear of other children. Supporters hold at the hips.

levels: Front Support Walking Between 2 Targets
Needle Kick Kicking SliderAgainst Wall/Block
Cartwheel, Kick Slider Against Wall (BACK FOOT ON SLIDER)
Dive Cartwheel, Kick Slider to Wall (BACK FOOT ON SLIDER)

cues: Keep your back foot on the slider.
Long straight legs, toes pointed.
Kick the slider, then lift and hold.
tips.watch: Bent legs and a short kick mean the slider barely moves. Ask for a long straight back leg and a fast needle kick, keeping the front leg straight too.
tips.safety: Sliders slip, so use them on a matted floor away from walkways and make sure only one child is near the wall at a time.

levels: Step to Lunge, Push over Wedge into Wall
Step to Lunge, Push over Wedge into Wall (keep leaning into the wall as it falls, hold)
Hurdle Jump to Lunge, Push Wedge into Wall (hide ears) How far away can they start?
Step and Swing Arms to Side (needle kick) to finish with back against the wall

0.s: Lunge hold for 3s on each leg (arms by ear)
Arms above head, on toes, lean forward to lunge position

cues: Big step into a strong lunge.
Arms by your ears, hide them.
Push through your arms, keep leaning in.
tips.watch: Arms drop forward and the head pokes out, so the push is weak. Remind them to hide their ears between their arms and push from the lunge, not just the hands.
tips.safety: Check the wedge is clear of other children before it falls, and that it falls against the wall, not onto anyone's feet.

intro: Practice good shapes, stretch, dish and arch (hide ears with arms)
What a half on is Most of them will likely round off as opposed to half on (just encourage the half on but don’t worry if they can’t)
Introduce Half On, Half Off (direction changes)

levels: Walk Legs up the Wall to Handstand, Hold 10s
Kick to Handstand
Handstand Shruggies
Face Wall, Cartwheel to Handstand with Belly Against the Wall

0.s: 3/4 Handstand against wall (stomach facing - feet only on wall)
Handstand against wall (stomach facing flat on wall)

1.s: Kick to show handstand (under arm swing)

cues: Straight arms, push the floor away.
Squeeze your tummy and bottom, legs together.
Look at your hands, not your feet.
tips.watch: Banana backs from loose tummies and bent arms. Get them to push tall through the shoulders and squeeze the bottom; shorten the hold or lower the feet on the wall if the shape goes.
tips.safety: Clear space beside the wall to cartwheel or step down. Teach them to step down sideways, not collapse onto the head.

levels: Backwards Jump to Stick
Half Turn Jump to Stick
Full Turn Jump to Stick
Half Turn Jump onto the Mat, Half Turn Off the Other Way

2.s: Full Jump Turn from 110cm vault and showing good landing

cues: Land on two feet and freeze like a statue.
Arms up, squeeze tight as you turn.
Soft knees on landing, chest up.
tips.watch: Turns that are short and wobbly because they look down or throw the arms. Keep arms up by the ears and eyes on a spot on the wall until they land.
tips.safety: Bend the knees on every landing, land on the balls of the feet; check landing mats are flat and not sliding apart.

levels: Half Turn on Toes Holding Noodle Above Head
Half Spin Holding Noodle Above Head
Full Spin Holding Noodle Above Head
Double Spin OR Full Spin, Step Reverse Spin

0.s: Half Turn on toes

cues: Noodle high, arms by your ears.
Up on your toes and stay tall.
Spot the wall, then whip your head round.
tips.watch: Dropping heels and arms coming down so they wobble out of the turn. Keep the noodle pressed up and stay high on the toes; slow it down to a half turn if needed.

levels: Squat On to the Vault, Backwards Jump or Half Turn Jump Off to Stick
Squat On to the Vault, Sideways Bunny Hop (like cartwheel prep) off the Vault
Squat On to the Vault, Round Off (with support)
FINAL SKILL: Half On over the Vault

0.s: Half Jump Turn from 1m vault and showing good landing
Half Jump Turn from 110cm vault and showing good landing

2.s: Half on or Round Off on 100cm vault using springboard

3.s: Half on to lie onto tummy (60cm mats) with springboard
Half on or Round Off on 100cm vault using springboard

cues: Hands flat on the vault, shoulders over your hands.
Kick your legs up high and together.
Push off your hands and land facing the vault.
tips.watch: Bent arms and shoulders behind the hands, so the legs never lift. Practise reaching the shoulders forward over the hands in the squat on before adding the kick.
tips.safety: Coach supports the round off and half on at the hips and waist, standing on the landing side. Check the vault and mats are stable and firm.

levels: Hands on Spot, Bunny Hop on EITHER Yellow or Green to the Other Side
Feet on Bosu, Walk Hands on EITHER Yellow or Green to the Other Side
Stand On 1 Leg on Bosu, Tap the Green Spots with Tiptoes (switch foot and onto yellow)

cues: Hands under shoulders, strong straight arms.
Squeeze your tummy so your hips stay still.
Tiny tiptoe taps, stay tall on one leg.
tips.watch: Hips sagging or sticking up in the hand walks and bunny hops. Ask for a flat back like a table and slower, smaller moves until the shape holds.
tips.safety: Bosu on a flat mat away from walls and other equipment; keep the next child back until the bosu is clear.

levels: Hands on Block, 5 Rebound Jumps
Hands on Block, 5 Rebound Jumps (kick backwards)
Hands on Block, 5 Rebound Jumps (heel drive high)
Hands on Block, Jump to Handstand (from as few jumps as possible)

cues: Quick bouncy feet, straight legs.
Shoulders over your hands, arms locked.
Drive your heels up to the ceiling.
tips.watch: Bent arms and shoulders leaning back, so the heels barely lift. Have them lean shoulders over the block before each jump and keep arms straight.
tips.safety: Check the block is solid and won't slide. Children going to handstand must have space to come down on their feet, not fall onto their back.

levels: Tucked Handstand (knees on block, hands on floor)
Piked Handstand (feet on block, hands on floor)
Piked Handstand (lift one foot at a time towards handstand)
Piked Handstand (lift up to handstand))

cues: Shoulders over your hands, push tall.
Make a tight upside-down V shape.
Lift one leg slowly, keep the other on the block.
tips.watch: Shoulders leaning back behind the hands, which puts weight on the feet and stops the lift. Walk hands a little closer to the block so shoulders stack over them.
tips.safety: Block must not move. Teach them to step down to the floor from a lift, never roll off over the head.

levels: Hands on the Red, Jump onto the Yellow and Jump Off
Hands on the Red, Jump over the Yellow (bunny jump/round off)
Half On Over the Vault Add the Half Off if Ready

0.s: Bunny hop on small block (showing hips lifting and support with both arms)

2.s: Half on to lie onto tummy (60cm mats) with springboard

cues: Hands on the red, shoulders forward.
Jump your hips high, legs together.
Land on two feet and stick it.
tips.watch: Diving in with hands too close to the feet, so hips stay low. Place a spot to show where hands go and cue a big jump of the hips up.
tips.safety: Coach supports the half on at the hips on the landing side. Check the blocks are stable and the landing area is matted.

intro: Show a lunge shape and show butterfly hands on the beam.

levels: Bunny Hops on the Floor Beam
Bunny Hops over the beam (can straighten legs)
Handstand on the beam
Cartwheel into a Handstand

0.s: From stand,bunny hop,return to stand

cues: Hands flat on the beam, shoulders over your hands.
Squeeze your legs together, lift your hips high.
Land softly, feet together, knees bent.
tips.watch: Shoulders lean back behind the hands, so hips stay low and feet crash down. Ask them to look at the beam between their hands and push tall through the arms.
tips.safety: On the high beam, stand at the side to support at the hips and thigh; never hold or push the head.

levels: Lunge Hold into T- Shape balance
Bunny Hop into Handstand, step down into a lunge- with Support
Handstand OR Split Handstand
Backward Walkover

0.s: Show lunge shape 3s
Show T Shape, return to lunge

cues: Big lunge, front knee bent, arms reaching up by your ears.
Make a T: arms, body and back leg in one line.
Long legs and pointed toes when you kick up.
tips.watch: Arms drop forward and the chest collapses in the lunge, so the balance or handstand tips over. Keep arms pinned by the ears from the lunge to the finish.
tips.safety: Support handstands and walkovers at the hips and lower back from the side; anyone not ready for walkovers practises on the floor beam.

levels: Sit Down and Stand up- Feet together OR Rock Backwards and stand up
Forward Roll with Support
Thin Beam Pad - Hold beam behind head, lift to shoulderstand and then rock to stand (Grade 14)
Thin Beam Pad- Forward Roll

cues: Chin on your chest, round your back like a ball.
Hold the beam tight behind your head.
Rock forward and reach your arms to stand up.
tips.watch: The head lifts or turns, so the roll goes crooked or off the side. Tell them to keep chin tucked and eyes on their knees all the way through.
tips.safety: Rolls and shoulderstands only on low beam or thin beam pad with mats; support at the hips and upper back, never push on the head or neck.

levels: Walk Sideways- Bunny Hop dismount sideways
Walk sideways on toes- Round off dismount
Cartwheel on brown line on Beam
Cartwheel on thin beam

cues: Little sideways steps, feet never cross.
Hand, hand, foot, foot along the line.
Stay tall and look at the end of the beam.
tips.watch: Cartwheels drift off the line because hands go down wide or crooked. Get them to place both hands on the line first and practise on the brown line before the thin beam.
tips.safety: Clear landing area for dismounts; mats either side of the beam for cartwheels.

levels: Bunny Hop on one leg
Backward Bunny Hop
Caterpillar on Beam
Push into a Bridge on Beam

cues: Hands flat, shoulders over your hands, hips up high.
Soft knees on every landing.
Push your tummy up to the sky.
tips.watch: Hops and caterpillars wander because the shoulders move off the hands. Ask for short, controlled hops and shoulders stacked over the hands each time.
tips.safety: Bridges on the beam only with a coach supporting under the lower back and mats either side; never press on the neck.

intro: Practice front support and bunny hops (straight arms)
Try to do high bunny hops - make sure they are in enough space from chains and each other
Talk about the hand placement when doing turns: over grip, under grip and mixed grip. Mixed grip is the important one

levels: Lay on back holding wall bars, roller over to belly and finish in in mixed grip (bean bag between feet)
Walk towards handstand on floor bar
Kick to handstand against wall bars in mixed grip
Kick to handstand in over grip, practice carefully lifting away one hand (not balance, like steps)

0.s: Hang on bar in mixed grasp - 5 Seconds

cues: Tight tummy, squeeze the bean bag with your feet.
Arms by your ears, push tall through your shoulders.
Look at your hands, not your feet.
tips.watch: A banana back with shoulders closed. Cue them to push tall through the shoulders and squeeze bottom and tummy; lower the height or go back a rung if they can't stay straight.
tips.safety: Teach a safe step-down before kicking up. Check wall-bar grip is secure and matting is under the hands and landing area.

levels: Small swings on low bar with help
Regrip swings on low bar, jump to land behind bar
Swings in mixed grip (both ways)
Swing half turn on either high or low bar

0.s: Hang on bar (overgrasp)- release to landing shape
5 Swings on High Bar (Coach Assist)

cues: Long body, legs squeezed together.
Kick forwards, regrip at the back.
Turn your hips first, then swap one hand.
tips.watch: Bent arms and piking on the swing. Keep arms straight, stay long and tight, kick from the hips at the front and regrip only at the back of the swing.
tips.safety: Children let go at the back of the swing, never the front. Mats under the whole swing; on half turns stand to the side ready at the waist.

levels: Front support on floor bar, lift hands 1 at a time balancing cone on back
Front support on floor bar with feet raised on block, lift hands 1 at a time (over/mixed/under grip)
Piked handstand hands on floor bar, change hands from over to mixed to under grip
From knees to handstand hold OR coach support 1 handed handstand or handstand half turn

0.s: Front Support on Floor Bar - (5 Seconds) Tight Shape !

cues: Push the floor away with straight arms.
Move your weight across before lifting a hand.
Thumbs wrap round the bar.
tips.watch: Hips sag and shoulders collapse when a hand lifts. Make them push tall and shift weight to the other hand first; shorter holds with good shape beat long wobbly ones.
tips.safety: For supported handstands, hold at the hips and thighs, never the head. Keep the floor bar on matting so it can't slide.

levels: Monkey bars from one side to the other, bean bag between feet
Half turn monkey bars (make sure belly faces one way then the other on each step
High casts and back hip circle with support Can undershoot ½ turn if able
Cast to handstand with support

0.s: Monkey Bar Traverse (1 Bar Length)

cues: Hold tight, thumbs round the bar.
Belly faces one way, then the other.
Straight arms, lean shoulders forward, then kick back.
tips.watch: Casts done with bent arms and a pike, so the hips barely leave the bar. Keep arms locked, lean shoulders over the bar and stay tight before kicking back.
tips.safety: Mats under the monkey bars. For supported casts and cast to handstand, support at the thighs and front of the shoulder; one coach per child.

levels: Jump and kick back holding bar
Jump holding bar, kick towards front support
Jump to straddle onto the bar or jump to kick toward handstand (coach support if going towards handstand)
Jump all the way to handstand, or jump to straddle onto block, straddle jump up to handstand SUPPORTED

1.s: From High Box - Jump to Front Support (Straight Arms)
c: Jump to front support with straight arms

cues: Shoulders forward over your hands.
Jump from two feet, hips up high.
Push down hard through straight arms.
tips.watch: Shoulders stay behind the hands, so the hips can't lift. Cue them to lean shoulders over the bar as they jump and push down through straight arms.
tips.safety: Support at the hips and thighs for anything going towards handstand. Blocks must be stable and not able to slide.

intro: Hopping side to side, Jumping side to side, Bunny hop side to side, Front support arm lifts

levels: Stretch Jump to Land
Sideways Stretch Jump to Land
Sideways Half Turn Jump (start sideways, not forward)
Hop Sideways to Land (switch legs)

0.s: Stretch jump to hold landing 3s
Show Landing Shape for 3s
Show standing landing or plie position

2.s: 2 x Penguin Jumps into Half Jump Turn

cues: Arms reach to the ceiling, squeeze your legs together.
Turn your shoulders and hips together, as one piece.
Land on soft knees and freeze like a statue.
tips.watch: Children twist the arms or shoulders but leave the hips behind, so the jump ends up crooked. Ask them to keep arms by their ears and turn the whole body together.
tips.safety: One at a time on the fast track. Wait until the child in front has landed and moved off.

levels: Sideways Bunny Hops
Cartwheel
1 Handed Cartwheel
Dive/Free Cartwheel or Round Off

cues: Lunge, hands down in a line, one then the other.
Kick your legs high and straight over your head.
Finish facing the way you came, arms up.
tips.watch: Hands land next to each other and legs come over bent and low. Put two hand markers in a straight line and ask for tall legs that pass over the hands.
tips.safety: Only children with a solid cartwheel try the dive or free cartwheel; keep them on the fast track with a clear landing area.

levels: Jump and Hold, Shoulder/Safety Roll Out
Jump into Handstand Flatback
Run and ‘Ninja’ Roll
Side Somersault (these start facing forward but finish backwards) OR Barani

cues: Tuck your chin and roll over your shoulder, not your head.
Make a long, tight body when you hit the mat.
Go round your shoulder like a rolling log.
tips.watch: Children roll straight over the top of the head instead of across the shoulder. Show the diagonal line from shoulder to opposite hip and practise from kneeling first.
tips.safety: Side somersault and barani only for confident Advanced children with a coach present. Never roll on the head or neck; use a thick landing mat.

levels: Stand on Yellow Floor, Stretch Jump Up onto Each Level
Stand on Yellow Floor, Sideways Jump Up onto Each Level
Stand on Yellow Floor, Half Turn Jump Up onto Each Level
Stand on Yellow Floor, Sideways Hop or Half Turn Hop Up onto Each Level

0.s: Run and stretch jump onto 60cm block (using under arm swing technique)

cues: Swing your arms up and lift your knees to land.
Land on top with both feet, then stand tall.
Look at the level before you jump onto it.
tips.watch: Children jump short and catch their toes on the edge of the next level. Ask them to look at where they will land and swing the arms hard to get height.
tips.safety: Use stable, matted levels and step down rather than jumping back off. One child per level so no one lands on another.

levels: Sit in Pike and Swap Quoits from One Side to the Other
Sit in Tuck and Swap Quoits from One Side to the Other
Sit in Tuck, Lean Back and Swap Quoits from One Side to the Other (Russian Twist)
Lay in Dish, Lift to Tuck and Swap Quoits from One Side to the Other

cues: Sit tall, tummy tight, don't let your back slump.
Turn your shoulders to put the quoit right down beside you.
Keep your feet still while your arms move.
tips.watch: Feet and knees swing from side to side with the arms, so the tummy isn't working. Tell them to keep their knees pointing at the ceiling and only turn the shoulders.

levels: Sideways Jump to the End Squat On, Half Turn Jump Off Block
Egg Roll (sideways tuck roll) to the End Sideways Roll Over Block
From Hands and Knees, Roll Sideways to Back and Bounce to Hands and Knees Sideways Roll Over Block
Side Somersault Over the Block

cues: Squeeze into a tiny egg and roll over sideways.
Keep your knees together and hold your shins.
Land on two feet and freeze, arms up.
tips.watch: Children open out halfway through the sideways roll and flop onto their back. Ask them to hug their knees tight until they are all the way over.
tips.safety: Side somersault over the block only with a coach standing by. Make sure the landing side has a thick mat and the next child waits until it's clear.

warmups.focus: Shoulders and straddle shapes for cartwheels and handstand turns

mob.txt: Sit in straddle sit straight legs and pointed toes
8 Kicks Fwd,Bwd and Side on each leg

str.txt: Extended Front Support 3s (Return to Pike Stand)
Front Support Walk with slider (Tight Shape)

Forward Roll down a wedge with light support
Lunge hold for 3s on each leg (arms by ear)
Half Turn Jump
High knees running on the spot - 30s
Sprint 12m across floor area - line to line
10 x Penguin Jumps on Springboard (Arms by Side)
Jump into hoop with feet together (showing one foot to two feet action)
Walk 1 Length of Beam (One foot in front of another) - Floor Beam

Walk 1 Length of Beam Sideways - Medium Beam
Stretch up, Crouch Down and return to Stand - High Beam

Hang on bar in mixed grasp - 5 Seconds
Held Front Support (Coach Assist) - 5 Seconds
Monkey Bar Traverse (1 Bar Length)

3 (supported) tucked rolls without losing shape
Sit in pike with straight legs and pointed toes

Bear Crawl/spider run on length of floor

bars: Jump to front support with straight arms

vaultNote: Block 60cm, or vault min 60cm onto safety mat
Block 60cm, or vault min 60cm onto safety mat
rules: 2 piece (Floor & Vault) or 4 piece (Floor, Vault, Beam & Bars)
Positive 10.0: skill completion 4.0, shapes and technique 4.0, confidence and effort 2.0
Gold 8.0+, Silver 6.0–7.99, Bronze below 6.0: every gymnast gets a medal
